sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks everyone. I wanted a concise read on timelines for three big areas we called out: API (v2/stability), Console metrics + UX revamp, and Optimize (batching/cost heuristics). Which quarters are we targeting, what are the main blockers, and which items are gated on Dedicated/Private availability?

josh: Short answer: target windows below; details + risks after. Owners will post RFCs by EOD.

josh: ```
API v2 (stable): beta -> 2026-07-15, GA -> 2026-09-30
Console metrics revamp: preview -> 2026-06-20, beta -> 2026-08-15
Optimize batching (v1): alpha -> 2026-10-01, GA -> 2026-11-30
```

maria: Add nuance — API v2 GA depends on two infra items: KV cache eviction fix and cross-region routing polish. Both are on the eng-infra board; if either slips by >3 weeks GA shifts. Dedicated bump is not required for GA, but Dedicated customers will get early access for perf testing.

rachel: For Console: the metrics revamp includes token-level cost breakdown and per-route traces. UX work is on a separate sprint; we plan a limited preview with a subset of accounts in mid-June. Need SDK changes for streaming traces (pinging @devex for a short compatibility matrix).

dena: Optimize batching: core algorithm is done but we need more production traffic tests to tune thresholds. Private deployments (on-prem) will need a node-level config push; that gating story affects 1-month of rollout for Private customers only.

josh: Risks and tradeoffs: 
- If infra fixes take priority, Console UX might slide one sprint.
- We can ship API v2 GA with conservative default batching; Optimize full rollout will then be staged.
- Quantization/compatibility tests could add 2–4 weeks if regressions show up.

sam: Can we get owners to post a 2-sentence risk note + one-line mitigation by EOD tomorrow? @josh @maria @rachel

josh: Yep — I'll post the API v2 risk note and link to the infra tickets: https://go/redwood/api-v2-risks (internal).

maria: I'll post infra PRs and ETA updates to eng-infra channel and tag eng-sre for the routing polish.

rachel: Will update the Console preview signup doc and add the SDK compatibility checklist. Preview invites go out 2026-06-22.

dena: I'll coordinate production traffic tests and share the Optimize tuning runbook.

allhands-bot: Recording of the all-hands and Q&A is uploaded: https://go/redwood/allhands/2026-05-20 (auto-posted). :movie_camera:

sam: Awesome. Action items captured — owners to post short risk/mitigation notes, update boards, and we reconvene in the product sync next Tuesday to confirm dates. Thanks :thumbsup:

josh: Quick follow-up: I'm scheduling a 30-min cross-team sync for Friday to cover canary gating and Dedicated/private opt-ins. Invite shortly.

rachel: small ask — if anyone on this thread is running dashboards we rely on for latency baselines, please drop a note here with the dashboard link.

dena: Dropping ours: https://go/redwood/dashboards/optimize-latency (internal).

sam: Great — closing the loop. Please add any outstanding questions here and we'll triage.
